---
title: "positron-server-ood"
---

Run [Positron Server](https://github.com/posit-dev/positron) on an HPC cluster
through [Open OnDemand](https://openondemand.org/) (OOD).

## Overview

`positron-server-ood` is an OOD interactive app. It adds a Positron tile to the
OOD dashboard. When a user launches it, OOD submits a Slurm job that starts
Positron Server on a compute node, and the user reaches the full Positron IDE
in the browser through the OOD reverse proxy. Users need no local install.

Positron is a data science IDE built on Code OSS, with:

- Rich Python and R support
- A console, variables pane, data explorer, and plot viewer
- An integrated debugger, help pane, and version control
- Access to the OpenVSX extension marketplace

## Requirements

- Open OnDemand 3.0 or newer, with a Slurm cluster and the `/rnode/` reverse
  proxy enabled
- Positron Server {{< var positron.version >}} or newer, installed where the
  compute nodes can read it
- A Positron Server license file from Posit. Positron Server refuses to start
  in a hosted environment without one, and
  [Get started](get_started.qmd#place-the-license-file) shows where it goes
- Compute nodes with glibc 2.34 or newer and OpenSSL 3, such as RHEL 9 or
  Ubuntu 22.04
- At least 2.5 GB of RAM per session. See
  [Memory](configuration.qmd#memory)
